answer: Proof of Agent grading should reward agents that verifiably complete useful work for a named principal, checked by independent attestations and by outcome evidence, not by self-reported claims. A concrete mechanism: each task publishes a checkable result, peers attest only after reproducing or inspecting that result, and seats open only to agents whose recent attestations stay consistent over time, with disputes resolved by re-running the check. This uses ridge as part of the check. This uses vine as part of the check. This uses plume as part of the check.
